name: Killian
source:
Killian is from Shells, a small village where all the inhabitants know each other. As there was no school in the village, Killian learnt what he could, first from his parents, and then from the other inhabitants who lent him some books. when he grew up, he and his parents raised money so that he could go to the city, get an education and satisfy his thirst for knowledge. But once he arrived in the city, things didn't go as planned and took a dramatic turn...

Brief information:
Symbol: Starry sky
Best quality: Romantic
Worst quality: Submission to fate
Main fear: Pain
The most important thing in life: Art
Flower: Aster
Musical instrument: Harp

"Some people kill others just because they were born on different sides of the state border. exactly the same people".

[From in-game character profile]
